info.name: papi Account Info Trade Area Reports API

items.docs:
Returns trade area demographics. By default returns potential demographics (population living in the trade area). Set audienceType to captured in the request body to get captured demographics (home-CBG demographics of actual visitors).
Supported datasets to use are:
  • Census: ACS (2024)
  • STI: Popstats
  • STI: Landscape
  • STI: Market Outlook
  • STI: Spending Patterns
  • STI: Workplace

info.name: Trade Area by Drive Time Report

items.docs:
This service lets you retrieve the trade area polygon calculated for a specified drive time.

📍 This service supports the <>. Once setting a value to the nearbyRadius parameter, the report will be generated based on the nearby activity logic.

True Trade Areas are calculated by the volume of traffic reaching the venue or complex . For example, setting 'traffic vol' to 70% draws a polygon that represents 70% of the visitors’ home location.

⏱ Average measured processing time: 2.24 seconds
For more information on request retries best practices and processing measurements you may visit this page
